dimensions.blocker: The purchase-to-billing chain is implemented, but the premium website deliverable still lacks a verified paid external end-to-end completion under the corrected visual-quality gate.

dimensions.name: AI / agent capability
dimensions.blocker: Agents can build, inspect and repair pages, but the live builder overwrote staged image paths with fake binary placeholders and a repair attempt stopped on malformed output; unattended behavioral reliability is not yet strong enough.

dimensions.name: Website Builder maturity
dimensions.blocker: Yesterday's apparent elite-reference wins were materially inflated by a judge that was grading copy as visual quality. Under text-blind judging the same pages lose or tie, and the new mandatory repair stage has not yet demonstrated repeated convergence to the family floor.

dimensions.name: Commercial readiness
dimensions.blocker: The live offer, activation and billing infrastructure remain credible, but the strongest recent premium-deliverable evidence was revised downward and there is still no verified paid customer completion.

dimensions.name: Acquisition readiness
dimensions.blocker: No repeatable acquisition or lead-to-paid conversion loop is proven, and the public company still reports no customers.

dimensions.name: Business / economic proof
dimensions.blocker: No verified paying Stromation customers or recurring revenue exist yet; the venture portfolio remains parked and its last property retired.

changed: The single biggest change is a reversal of yesterday's Website Builder quality conclusion. The same Merritt and Emberline frames that appeared to beat elite references when their copy was visible lost or tied when the text was blinded, proving the prior visual judge was substantially grading writing rather than visual craft. Main now has the stronger split blind/visible jury, versioned certification path, truthful imagery policy and mandatory bounded repair stage, but the first live repair run left family standing unmoved and exposed additional asset/output defects. Technical maturity remains very high, while autonomy, reliability, Website Builder maturity and commercial confidence are marked down until the corrected pipeline repeatedly converges without operator-led repair.
method: Expanded independent forecast grounded in Sep. 15-16 main-branch merges through PR #187, the corrected text-blind certification evidence, the first live bounded repair-loop run, merged capture/asset/truth/repair hardening, the current generated purchase-to-billing implementation state, the public $1,000 setup + $1,250/month offer and explicit no-customer disclosure, parked venture status, and absence of verified recurring revenue. Forward-looking values are estimates, not guarantees.
